CustomField.description: How this assignment's partner was selected. Manual is a human-picked assignment (LeadDistributionService.assignLeadToPartner); Round Robin is resolved by LeadDistributionService.distributeLead from an active Lead_Distribution_Rule__mdt. Non-restricted so future strategies (mirroring Lead_Distribution_Rule__mdt.Distribution_Method__c's other values - Territory, Product Specialization, Partner Tier, AI Recommendation) can be added without a metadata deploy once they're actually built.
CustomField.label: Assignment Strategy
